meta.title: Improve Fortran constant list folding
meta.body_summary: Add constant list propagation to Fortran compiler to fold len, count, append, union, etc. when lists are stored in variables; document in TASKS.md and README.md.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit compiler optimization merged in seconds by the author with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 145 changed lines concentrated in one Go file, this is a small-scale edit by absolute volume. It fits a focused, low-risk compiler optimization that merged instantly without review.

review_details.performance_claim: Constant list propagation allows compile-time folding of len, count, append, union, except for list literals stored in variables.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler optimization within a narrow scope; agent produced a working change that the author merged immediately, indicating sufficient technical capability for a small code transformation with implicit testing.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or before/after metrics; only narrative claims and go test ./... command provided.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/fortran/compiler.go, added constant propagation for integer list literals so that operations like len, count, append, union, except can be folded at compile time when applied to constant lists; updated TASKS.md and README.md to document the new capability.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation updates only; no unrelated files.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding constant list propagation, modifying 140 lines in compiler.go and minor doc changes.

collaboration_trajectory: Author opened PR with single commit, self-labeled 'codex', and merged within 15 seconds; no external review or comments.
